body.statement:
In the additional subregime \(T_N/N\to0\), uniformly over \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{fit}}\),
\[
 \sqrt{NT_N}(\overline\theta_N-\theta_N)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,Q),
 \qquad
 \mathbb P\{\theta_N\in I_{\mathrm{diff}}\}=1-\alpha+o(1).
\]
Moreover \(\overline\theta_N-\widetilde\theta_N=O_{\mathbb P}(N^{-1})\) uniformly.  Thus the diffusion fitted center is an \(O(N^{-1})\)-accurate corollary, and the available residual bound makes \(T_N/N\to0\) sufficient for its Wald limit; this restriction is not imposed on exact finite-chain fitted-center inference.
body.proof_tex:
For any \(p'\in[c/2,2C]^3\) and fixed interior \(M\), put \(g'=(M-Na(p'))/\sqrt N\).  The control stationary mean is exactly \(a_0(p')\), while the treatment stationary mean is
\[
 a(p')+N^{-1/2}\mathbb E_{\rho_{1,N}^{p',M}}X_{1,N}^{p',M}.
\]
Because \(M=\lceil Na(p')+g'\sqrt N\rceil\), the centering consequence of Theorem \(\mathrm{kink\mbox{-}residual\mbox{-}bound}\), applied on the enlarged compact rate box \([c/2,2C]^3\) and staffing window \([-G-1,G+1]\), gives
\[
 \left|\vartheta_N(p';M)-\left\{a_0(p')-a(p')-N^{-1/2}m_{p',g'}\right\}\right|
 \leq K N^{-1}.                                                  \tag{19}
\]
The rate-score law implies \(\widehat p-p=O_{\mathbb P}((NT_N)^{-1/2})\) and hence
\[
 \widehat\gamma_N-\gamma_N
 =-\sqrt N\{a(\widehat p)-a(p)\}=O_{\mathbb P}(T_N^{-1/2}).      \tag{20}
\]
Since \(|\gamma_N-\gamma|\leq N^{-1/2}\), the enlarged-window event used in (19) has probability tending to one uniformly.  Taking \(p'=\widehat p,M=M_N\) in (19) proves \(\overline\theta_N-\widetilde\theta_N=O_{\mathbb P}(N^{-1})\).  Its normalized magnitude is
\[
 \sqrt{NT_N}\,O_{\mathbb P}(N^{-1})=O_{\mathbb P}(\sqrt{T_N/N})=o_{\mathbb P}(1)                 \tag{21}
\]
under \(T_N/N\to0\).  The exact-center limit and consistency of \(\widehat Q\) from Theorem \(\mathrm{fitted\mbox{-}center\mbox{-}wald}\), followed by (21) and the continuity of the normal distribution function, prove both assertions.
body.justification: This corollary isolates the sole use of the fitted-horizon condition.
body.gap: It quantifies the price of replacing exact product-law centering by the diffusion mean.
body.consumer: Implementers may choose the cheaper diffusion center when monitoring duration grows more slowly than enrollment.
